name: Aprilia SR50 / Rally 50
engine: 49 cc two-stroke single, air- or liquid-cooled, oil injection, CVT
intro: Aprilia's sporty 50 scooters. Two-strokes with oil injection, a CVT and lots of tuning parts.

B: It has oil injection, not premix. Keep the oil tank filled with two-stroke oil and check the pump line for cracks.

recallNote: Aprilia has issued recalls on some bikes in these years. Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls before you start.
